items.headline: 400 Saratoga Avenue: 316 apartments proposed on golf course land
items.summary: The Planning Commission's November 18 agenda listed a public hearing on whether to recommend amending the General Plan and rezoning 400 Saratoga Avenue. The project would build a five-story, 316-unit apartment building, reconfigure the existing nine-hole golf course, and dedicate land for a public park. An Environmental Impact Report was prepared and circulated for public review.

items.headline: Townhomes and a duplex with shop space proposed on Civic Center Drive
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed a vesting tentative subdivision map for condominium purposes covering 14 townhomes and a duplex building with commercial space. The site is at 858 and 860 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street. The project is exempt from CEQA under AB 130 (2025).

items.headline: Neighbor appeals Rita Court home addition approval
items.summary: The November 18 Planning Commission agenda listed an appeal of a staff-level approval for a home expansion at 2261 Rita Court. The approved plan adds 517 square feet downstairs and a 1,000-square-foot second floor to a single-story house on a 6,272-square-foot lot.

items.headline: Cupertino council agenda lists closed session on YIMBY and Chen lawsuits
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed a closed-session conference with legal counsel on two existing lawsuits in Santa Clara County Superior Court: Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino, et al., and Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino, et al. The agenda gives no description of the claims.

items.headline: Cupertino council agenda includes ordinance on council compensation
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed an ordinance amending Cupertino Municipal Code Section 2.16.020, which covers City Council compensation. The agenda excerpt does not give the proposed amounts.

items.headline: Council agenda lists changes to community funding and festival fee waivers
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed council subcommittee recommendations on the Community Funding Policy and on festival fee waivers. The same agenda included amendments to the Council Procedures Manual, an item postponed from May 5, 2026.

items.headline: Council agenda: deferring vote on 590-unit El Camino Real project
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed an action to defer consideration of a vesting tentative map and development agreement for a mixed-use project at 2610 El Camino Real with 590 residential units and 15,000 square feet of commercial space. The project is subject to SB 330, the 2019 state housing law.

items.headline: Council special meeting set on Convention Center finances
items.summary: A 5:30 PM special meeting of the City Council on November 17 was listed to give an overview of the Santa Clara Convention Center's financial status reports. The reports covered the fourth quarter of FY 2024/25 and all four quarters of FY 2025/26.
